name: Lapine
body:
The lapine are a forest-dwelling species of bunny-like humanoids with an exceptional connection to magic and the world around them.

Lapine Ancestral Traits
Ability Score Modifiers: Lapine are known for their grace and supernatural senses, but tend to be frail compared to other humanoids. +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, -2 Constitution
Size: Lapine are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Type: Lapine are humanoids with the lapine subtype.
Fast Speed: Lapine are faster than average for their size, and have a base speed of 35 feet.
Natural Senses: Lapine get a +2 racial bonus to Perception check and +1 racial bonus to Handle Animal.
High Jumper: Lapine legs are naturally well-suited to jumping. When making a high jump, lapine are always treated as having a running start and get a +4 racial bonus to the Acrobatics check.
Bow Familiarity: The lapine’s specialty is archery. They are proficient in longbows and short bows (including composite versions of both) and treat any weapon with the word “bow” in it as marital weapons.
Honored Craftsmanship: The lapine are renowned for their woodworking and dedicated to their crafts. Lapine gain Skill Focus as a bonus feat, and must select Craft, Profession or Perform.
Word of the Forest: Lapine have a natural connection with the spirit world that gives them supernatural senses. Once per day, while in forest terrain, a lapine can cast word of the forest and read weather as spell-like abilities, using their Wisdom as their spellcasting ability score, and their character level as their caster level.
Divination Specialty: Lapine get a +1 racial bonus to caster level for all divination spells and spell-likes.
Magic Sensitivity: Due to their connection to the spirit world, a lapine’s mental state is sometimes very sensitive to magic. This causes a lapine to get a -1 racial penalty on Will saves versus mind-affecting spells. However, once per day when failing a save against a non-harmless spell, a lapine can rage, as per the spell, using double the spell level of the original spell failed for the caster level.
Languages: Lapine begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. Lapine with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following: Catfolk, Draconic, Elven, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, and Lizzear. See the Linguistics skill page for more information about these languages.
Alternate Ancestral Traits
Hunter: Some lapine take more pride in their stealth than their speed. While in forest terrain, these lapine gain a +2 racial bonus to Stealth and reduce the penalty for using Stealth while moving by 5 and can make Stealth checks while running at a –20 penalty. This replaces high jumper.
Magic Sight: Some lapine are more directly in tune to the magic around them, distinguishing others from auras instead of appearances and physically seeing magic. They can cast detect magic as a spell-like ability at-will. This replaces word of the forest.
Urbanite: Some lapine are born away from their traditional communities. Often liked among other cultures, these lapine gain a +2 racial bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff with creatures of other subtypes that find them attractive. Additionally, once per day they can cast ears of the city as a spell-like ability, using their Wisdom as their spellcasting ability score, and their character level as their caster level. This replaces word of the forest.
